body: The fleet console's key line: one fixed line of short key labels (quit, move, last, pause, release, focus, review, send, switch, answer, open) that fits inside 79 columns on an 80-column terminal, never wrapping.
The key line is a fixed CLI string: its new text is held by a literal pin in a test, and its copy follows the design's wording.
The console still has no key trap: the quit key stays named on the shortened key line, and every key the line names stays reachable.
The key line carries no information by colour alone: any SGR on it stands beside its word, and none is written off a colour-capable terminal.

The console as the named exception to refusals never blocking the human: refusals it shows are the verb's own unable and hint lines, to the human who typed the action, uncoloured, each ending with its hint.
viola up output: one instance line per instance restored or started, parent first, each window on its recorded workspace.

viola revive and start refusals a resumed session can raise (no session, session live, already live, stale heartbeat, cwd missing), human pair and --json document, if the start path's resume by id or newest transcript reaches them.

A wait that prints the last message and a pending dialog's text: viola wait output and its waiting line, the dialog-pending critical path, with control characters in that vendor text escaped before printing.

Time bounds the new start and restore steps stay inside: each compositor read bounded at 5 s and read-only, the window step's wait at 5 s, viola open's live wait at 30 s, a switch's reap wait at 10 s; every bound falls on the driver, never on the human.
A read-back that an instance came up: printed through the verify step line or the board, plain words with code words beside unable, no spinner.

The live steps' guard: every live rig or step reads the board with no claude reachable on its PATH, or under a private config, proven by its rehearsal form over the fakes; no credential copy and no code that copies one.

The live readings this chunk names (the reboot reading, the launch pair, the switch readings, the window step's focus and failure readings, the founder's confirmation) are gated on his host and never gate the build; manual checks stay supplemental.
Model and effort handed again on a resumed or started session: any new flag or refusal they add is a CLI refusal in the word, detail and hint form, with its exit code.

body_fields.convention: every new a11y assertion runs inside the existing test suites and the coverage suite, its failure a nextest failure, no separate a11y driver
every new fixed CLI string or refusal line is pinned by its literal in a test
every new test is deterministic, never skipped and never retried; a gate breach fails the build
every new live step or live reading is supplemental and gates nothing; its rehearsal form is what CI runs

body: The console key line: one line of at most 79 columns under the 80-column width floor. Each key keeps its action; only the labels get shorter. The console's key reader stays bounded and closed over the same keys.

The rule that security refusals never block the human is amended to name the console as its exception. The refusals the console shows are the verb's own lines, shown to the human who typed the action. No refusal changes origin, and no code changes.
The console still runs its actions as children of its own exe and hands typed text to its verbs as data only. Changing the key line changes neither the verbs nor the text they get.

The guard for live steps: any live rig or live step this chunk builds or arms reads the board with no claude reachable on its PATH, or under a private config isolated from the user's Claude config. It is proven by the step's rehearsal form over the fake agent.

The R4b reboot reading's live arm refuses until the operator gives his word. Neither the arm nor its rehearsal copies a credential, and the chunk adds no code that copies one (his U6 answer, arm 3). It never reads the operator's Claude home or viola home.

Live steps act only on what they start themselves. They key only into their own pty, end only their own processes, and move or close only their own terminal's window. They dispatch nothing to the compositor; the only compositor calls are named read-only queries, held to a deadline.
The real claude CLI runs only locally, never in CI. CI holds no secrets. Rehearsals and tests run over the fake agent in their own homes.

Resuming a session by its own logged id, or by the folder's newest transcript: the id goes on the child's argv as one element of closed shape, with no shell. The transcript path is shape-checked and the transcript read is bounded.

Handing the model and effort again on start and resume: the launch-pair flags are checked before anything is read and refused after the dashes. The effort word is checked in the Claude adapter. The pair crosses on the claude child's argv and is kept to the snapshot and the event log only.

A terminal per instance on a named workspace: viola open spawns its terminal directly, under its closed argument allowlist. Window placement moves only the wrapper's own terminal window. The recorded window and origin authenticate nothing and are shown only when they re-parse.

An opening message into a resumed session goes in as typed text: one bracketed paste, held to the paste text character set and refused whole (never stripped) when it breaks the set. Empty text is refused, and the wrapper re-checks the text.

A wait that prints the last message and a pending dialog's text: that text is upstream content and never a command. Human output escapes control characters in it, and only closed words reach the refusal and diagnostics lines.

The read-back that an instance came up uses the board: the list scan checks the home and the strict modes before it opens anything, and refuses the whole board on a readable home. Lineage, links, window and launch pair are shown only when they re-parse.

The viola up, revive and open start path, touched only as measured: up checks the home tree and strict modes before its log opens and before any spawn, and starts parents first. Revive spawns in the recorded cwd only after its strict-modes check. The start collision check refuses an already-live or stale-heartbeat name.
The lineage readers: a self-reported parent and the from field authenticate nothing. Lineage is kept to the snapshot and the event log, and only names that re-parse are shown.
An instance driven by another binary: the pinned viola copy is re-hashed by SHA-256 before use and is never replaced. Adopt acts on no process it did not start.

What a rehearsal or live step records: live-rig records keep only closed words and counts. They hold no transcript bytes, no CLI output, and no paths, pids or ids in refusals. Any kept stamp is owner-only and seeded in the step's own home.
The parent's identity and inherited CLAUDE credential variables are stripped from any claude child that a start or restore spawns. The strip reads variable names only and serialises no credential.
